scope: Workstation saved Codex conversation catalog; Android and web consume this backend.
invariants: Ephemeral native runtimes are not durable saved conversations.
Explicit native persistence can admit the same identity; product ownership cannot be overridden.
Exact identity-bearing native absence is separate from archive and transient transport failure.
Fresh evidence wins over an older negative result; overlapping read tracking is released.
Unresolved human outgoing delivery prevents silent removal.
Canonical external archive cannot be resurrected by the saved metadata cache.
Saved histories, drafts and receipts are retained.
limits: Physical Android UI was not independently inspected.
A legitimate empty persisted session remains a valid native session; lack of a preview alone does not remove it.
No broad claim that every future native error means absence.
